main_text.l: genubus advolvitur, Divinæ gloriæ servire natus; sinum
pandas: ejus, imò religionis, cui causa militat,
Helveticas, ex quarum illc gremio prodit,
ἰσόττμον πίςιν, pretiosam æquè fidem sortitas, &
pro eadem per Christi gratiam depugnaturas semper,
quas in oculis Te ferre abundè constat; gratiâ &
favore perpetuo complecti ne desinas, quesitissimis,
humillimisque precibus contendo. Nos quoque unà cum
Ditioni Tuæ, quacunque Sol oriens & cadens
Germanicum Solum lustrat, subditis, qui Te, Carissimum
suspiciunt, orisque sui Spiritum æstimant, causam

page.notes: Catchword and signature absent. Greek phrase "ἰσόττμον πίςιν" as printed (ἰσότιμον πίστιν) is a probable printing irregularity; transcribed as seen. Some words in the lower lines are faint [?].
